channel.title: TrendingTesla
channel.description: The Tesla ecosystem and the AI race, explained.

item.title: Tesla now lets owners precondition the battery manually
item.description: Software update 2026.44.3.1 adds Precondition for Fast Charging in the car and in the Tesla app. The control warms the battery for DC fast charging, and normal home charging does not need it.

item.title: Tesla wants to buy assets of EMAG
item.description: Tesla notified Germany's Federal Cartel Office on 23 November 2026 of a planned acquisition of assets of the EMAG group, case B5-132/26, and the authority listed that review on 27 November 2026. The price and terms were not disclosed, and there is no clearance yet.

item.title: Tesla passes a thousand registered Cybercabs in Texas
item.description: Tesla registered a record 285 Cybercabs in Texas on Thanksgiving, 26 November 2026, the biggest one-day jump so far. The Texas roster now lists 1,107 Cybercabs, the first time that count has passed a thousand.

item.title: Tesla now leads German private EV switchers
item.description: Tesla took 10.1 percent of private German switches from a combustion car to a pure electric car in the first nine months of 2026, up from 4.5 percent a year earlier. HUK-COBURG's E-Barometer, published on 26 November 2026, puts the brand first for the first time.

item.title: Tesla cancels every Cybertruck reservation in Taiwan
item.description: On 26 November 2026 Tesla Taiwan told Cybertruck reservation holders that production will gradually stop and that their reservations are cancelled. The NT$3,000 deposit is refunded automatically, and a new Model 3 or Model Y on the same account can come with eight years of free Premium Connectivity.

item.title: Tesla nearly doubles its Dallas Robotaxi area
item.description: On 25 November 2026 Tesla's Robotaxi account posted a wider Dallas map and wrote that there are more cars and lower prices. Estimates traced from that map put the zone at about 150 square miles, up from about 81 to 82.

item.title: Neuralink gets FDA approval for pivotal ALS trial
item.description: On 25 November 2026 the FDA approved Neuralink to launch the LINK Pivotal Study in people with severe paralysis from ALS. The approval covers the trial and does not authorize sale of the implant.

item.title: SpaceX pledges one share per active Trump Account
item.description: On 25 November 2026 SpaceX said it will contribute one newly issued Class A share to every currently active Trump Account. The company says Elon Musk will match that number of shares, and Gwynne Shotwell has announced a separate personal gift of more than 2 million shares.

item.title: FCC authorizes one million Starmind data satellites
item.description: On 25 November 2026 the FCC Space Bureau granted SpaceX conditional authority for Starmind, up to 1 million low-Earth-orbit satellites that would work as orbital data centers. The first one must be operating by 25 November 2033.

item.title: Starlink Mini costs 99 dollars in the US
item.description: On 24 November 2026 Starlink cut the United States price of the Starlink Mini kit to 99 dollars, from a typical 249 dollars, and it is the lowest price the Mini has had. The kit is hardware only: a Roam plan and shipping are extra, and the Canadian kit has its own price.

item.title: Tesla raises the Cyberbeast price to $114,990
item.description: On 24 November 2026 Tesla raised the US Cyberbeast price by $5,000, from $109,990 to $114,990, before fees and taxes. It is the only Cybertruck trim a US buyer can still order new, and a new order is estimated as late as June 2027.

item.title: EU delays Tesla Assisted Driving meeting to mid-December
item.description: On 25 November 2026 a European Commission spokesperson told Reuters the Technical Committee on Motor Vehicles will meet on 15 December to consider Tesla's bid for EU-wide approval of Tesla Assisted Driving. The meeting had been set for 1 December, Flanders then put it on 7 December, and a vote is still not guaranteed.

item.title: Starlink gives up its US broadband subsidies
item.description: On 23 November 2026 the US NTIA published a zero-outlay BEAD model agreement, and SpaceX agreed to serve every awarded Starlink location at no cost to the program. Households still pay a monthly bill and only the customer equipment is free.

item.title: Tesla EU registrations rose 83.5 percent in October
item.description: Tesla registered 10,166 new cars in the EU in October 2026, up 83.5 percent from a year earlier, in ACEA figures published on 24 November 2026. Battery-electric cars took nearly 30 percent of the market that month, and BYD registered about three times as many cars as Tesla.

item.title: Five directors are negotiating the Tesla SpaceX merger
item.description: The Financial Times reported on 24 November 2026 that five directors, three from Tesla and two from SpaceX, are negotiating a possible combination worth about $3.5 trillion. The companies have not confirmed the names.

item.title: Tesla has its best day since April 2025
item.description: Tesla shares were up about 12% on 23 November 2026, trading around $387, and were on pace for the largest one-day percentage gain since 9 April 2025. The stock is still down about 13% for the year and about 20% below its record close.

item.title: Musk told SpaceX staff it lags in AI
item.description: On 23 November 2026 The New York Times reported that Elon Musk told SpaceX employees the company is falling behind in AI. Outlets relaying that report say Anthropic pays about $3.1 billion a month, and Google about $800 million, to rent SpaceX computing power.

item.title: Nvidia brings Jensen Huang back as CEO
item.description: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director on 23 November 2026, eleven days after he resigned. The board cited input from senior US government officials. Nvidia shares opened about 30% higher.

item.title: Two states sue SpaceX over Grok images
item.description: Virginia and Oregon filed the first US state lawsuits against SpaceX over Grok on 23 November 2026. The consumer-protection suits allege non-consensual sexualized images, including child sexual abuse material, and seek penalties, stricter guardrails and disgorgement.

item.title: Musk wants Starlink in every Tesla by 2027
item.description: On 22 November 2026 Elon Musk replied on X that an embedded Starlink option would hopefully be available towards the end of next year, a window that points to late 2027. He tied it to unsupervised FSD and said China is excluded because Starlink is illegal there.

item.title: SpaceX relaunched from one pad after 32 hours
item.description: SpaceX flew two Falcon 9 rockets from SLC-4E at Vandenberg 32 hours, 3 minutes and 21 seconds apart, its fastest turnaround from one pad. NROL-136 lifted off on 22 November 2026 after USSF-317 on 20 November.

item.title: Neuralink enrolled 21 people in its trials
item.description: On 28 January 2026 Neuralink said 21 people were enrolled in its trials worldwide. Reuters reported the same figure the same day. The company also said it had no serious device-related adverse events.

item.title: Tesla taped out the AI5 chip design
item.description: On 15 April 2026 Elon Musk said Tesla's team had taped out the AI5 chip. Electrek and TechNode both reported the post. Tape-out sends a finished design to be manufactured.

item.title: Tesla shut down the Dojo training computer
item.description: In August 2025 Bloomberg reported that Tesla was disbanding the Dojo team. Musk then said Dojo 2 was an evolutionary dead end and that the work would focus on AI5 and AI6.

item.title: A household socket supplies about 1300 watts
item.description: Tesla's Gen 2 Mobile Connector manual rates the ordinary household adapter at 1.3 kW on a 120-volt socket. Electrek reported the same 1.3 kW ceiling.

item.title: New Teslas lost the included mobile charger
item.description: Tesla stopped including the Mobile Connector with new orders after 17 April 2022 and sold the cable separately. Musk cited low use.

item.title: Tesla's wall charger also fits other cars
item.description: Tesla's Universal Wall Connector charges NACS cars and, with a built-in J1772 adapter, other electric cars. Its top output is 11.5 kW.

item.title: Tesla started Semi deliveries in Nevada
item.description: On 24 September 2026 Tesla handed Semi trucks to customers from its factory in Sparks, Nevada. It still did not publish a price or a delivery count.

item.title: Neuralink participant plays GTA VI with his mind
item.description: On 20 November 2026 Neuralink posted a video of about two minutes in which a clinical-trial participant plays GTA VI with his brain implant, one day after the game’s worldwide release. The implants remain investigational and are not approved by the FDA or other regulators.

item.title: HSBC more than doubles its Tesla price target
item.description: On 20 November 2026 HSBC analyst Michael Tyndall upgraded Tesla to Hold from Reduce and raised the price target to $359 from $157, about 129 percent higher, on a possible SpaceX combination. The new target is still below Tesla's close of $374.41 on 19 November.
